title: Miles v0.1 targets production-scale reinforcement learning
friendlyTitle: Miles helps teams improve large AI models after training
summary: RadixArk and ecosystem partners released Miles v0.1, a full-stack system for large-scale model post-training. It combines SGLang rollouts, asynchronous reinforcement learning, isolated agent environments, multiple training backends and support for NVIDIA and AMD hardware.
friendlySummary: Miles is an open system for teaching large models with reinforcement learning. It keeps different parts of the work running at the same time and supports several types of hardware.
whyItMatters: Open post-training infrastructure lowers the engineering barrier for research teams that need tool-using or long-running models tuned to specific tasks. Its asynchronous design is particularly relevant when agent trajectories vary widely in length and would otherwise leave expensive hardware idle.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Research teams may be able to train specialised AI agents more efficiently instead of building the whole system from scratch.
